Name: Moon Cycle
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]A simple small immersion mod, this makes the moon always visible in the night sky of the shipping profits screen on sunny days. It will cycle from a full moon on the 1st of the season to a new moon on the 7th and back to a full moon on the 14th before starting again, leading to two full moon cycles per season.

Keep an eye out for several special lunar sights on nights when the moon is full, including one special easter egg if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/2481]Sunberry Village [/url]installed!

Does not affect tides, fish, special events, or anything else. This is a purely visual mod.

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868]Weather Wonders [/url]by Kanadeyoru installed, the moon will also match that mod's lunar events.

[/size][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][size=3]

Simply extract the "[CP] Moon Cycle" folder and drop it into your Mods folder.[/size]
